title: Help with Analysis of "PERCY" Movie Structure

commenti.body: I mean are you just asking this sub to do your homework for you? Have you watched Percy yet? What are some ideas you have about it and what specifically do you need help thinking about? You have to do the thinking and work to get through class and learn things. Surprised you're not just paying someone to do it for you. I guess you're broke?

If you cannot manage this then you should not be on the course.

This may seem harsh, but these are basic ideas on cinematic storytelling that you should not already be scratching your head over.
